name: Process Mapper
problem: Discovery calls are long and unstructured. Process Mapper turns a call transcript into a process map with the steps, stakeholders, unstated gaps, follow-up questions and a draft diagram.
line: Turns a discovery call transcript into a process map with steps, stakeholders, gaps, follow-up questions and a draft diagram.

name: SOP Generator
problem: Workflows fail when nobody knows how they run. SOP Generator turns a rough process description, typed or spoken, into a numbered SOP with the purpose, ordered steps, tools and exceptions. Contact details are removed before the text reaches the model.
line: Turns a rough process description, typed or spoken, into a numbered SOP with purpose, steps, tools and exceptions.

name: Meeting Minutes Extractor
problem: Decisions and owners get lost after a call. The extractor turns a transcript or spoken recap into minutes with the decisions, action items with owners and deadlines, and open questions. Nothing is stored beyond the minutes.
line: Turns a transcript or spoken recap into minutes with decisions, owners, deadlines and open questions.

name: Executive Briefing Generator
problem: Founders keep notes, emails and to-dos in five places. The generator turns those fragments into a one-page brief with the top three priorities, the decisions only the founder can make, tasks to delegate and items that can wait.
line: Turns a day of notes, emails and to-dos into a one-page brief with priorities, decisions, tasks to delegate and what can wait.

name: Cold Outreach Personalizer
problem: Outbound stalls when every prospect gets the same email. The tool writes a tailored three-email sequence for each prospect in a batch and labels each one grounded or generic.
line: Writes a tailored three-email sequence for each prospect in a batch, each one labelled grounded or generic.

name: Investor Update Drafter
problem: Founders skip investor updates when the numbers are scattered. The drafter turns raw metrics and bullets into a clean update, with growth, runway and headcount change computed in code, never by the model.
line: Turns raw metrics and bullets into an investor update, with growth, runway and headcount change computed in code.

name: Automation Priority Sorter
problem: Teams automate whatever is loudest, not whatever frees the most time. Claude scores each logged manual pain point for automatability, priority and time saved, and ranks it in a shared backlog.
line: Scores each logged manual pain point for automatability, priority and time saved, and ranks it in a shared backlog.
